title: FreeTheDream
description: A shared map of the community's projects. Suggest an idea, approve it as the admin, and watch it join the web.

images.alt: The FreeTheDream demo: a round map of community projects in a yin-yang of sea and night sky, each project a labelled circle, with a project list beside it and a strip saying the data is made up.
The Suggestions panel beside the map, listing two made-up project ideas, Rooftop Garden and Repair Café, each waiting for review with a Follow button.
The admin Review panel beside the map, with Add to the map and Not this time buttons for each suggested project.
